Package neqsim.process.equipment.powergeneration.gasturbine

Class PlatformPowerSystem

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.powergeneration.gasturbine.PlatformPowerSystem
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class PlatformPowerSystem extends Object implements Serializable
Screening model of a platform or complex power system: site-rated gas-turbine generators, optional power from shore, waste-heat recovery (WHRU) on the generator exhaust and an optional steam bottoming cycle (combined-cycle yield).

For an ambient temperature and an electric (and heat) demand evaluate(double, double, double) dispatches shore power first (or last, see setShorePriority(boolean)), shares the rest over the in-service gas turbines in proportion to their site rating, runs each GasTurbineUnit at its share (fuel, exhaust flow and temperature, CO2), adds the recovered exhaust heat and deducts the electric output of the bottoming cycle, and reports the capacity, the deficit, the N-1 margin and the heat balance. evaluateAcrossAmbient(double[], double, double) repeats it over an ambient-temperature distribution, which is the usual form of the question "does power capacity bind on a hot day?".

Mechanical-drive turbines that sit on a compressor shaft are modelled with CompressorShaft.setGasTurbineUnitDriver(neqsim.process.equipment.powergeneration.gasturbine.GasTurbineUnit); this class covers the electric and heat side. Use CoupledProcessEnergySolver when the power system must be coupled to a running process model.

    • setWasteHeatRecovery

      public void setWasteHeatRecovery(double bottomingYield, double stackTemperatureK, double effectiveness)
      Configure the waste-heat recovery and an optional steam bottoming cycle.
      Parameters:
      bottomingYield - electric output per unit of recovered heat consumed by the bottoming cycle (0 = no bottoming cycle; about 0.25 for a steam cycle on GT exhaust)
      stackTemperatureK - gas outlet temperature of the WHRU [K]
      effectiveness - fraction of the exhaust heat above the stack temperature that is recovered (0 to 1)
